items.statement: Adult, voluntary acceptance, and understanding of confidentiality, least privilege, release, stop, and incident duties.
No authorship, edit, approval, implementation, testing, or validation of restricted fixture content, expected labels, rationales, comparison logic, or the submission.
No disclosure, copying, outside retention, exposure, or known prior compromise of a key or presentation.
Not a scorer, calibration administrator, recorder, adjudicator, participant, primary submission author, or presentation operator for the attempt.
No supervisory, financial, household, close-personal, reporting-line, authorship, or outcome-contingent conflict.
Can keep keys deny-by-default in the approved compartment with no local copy, message, screenshot, printout, log, or ad hoc export.
Will verify protocol/dataset/subset/key versions and digests and release only the exact matching subset to the deterministic loader.
Will verify complete lock, lock digest, eligibility digest, separation, time order, and attempt number before release.
Will keep retry material inaccessible until a valid primary failure, bounded remediation, renewed attestations, non-exposure confirmation, and retry authority all exist.
Will not disclose answer-bearing material, manually score, or communicate correctness hints.
Will produce only the bounded attributed release receipt required by schema.
Will stop and report uncertainty, mismatch, early/excess request, substitution, abnormal access, exposure, coercion, or bypass attempt.
Voluntarily accepts minimization, purpose, access, retention, deletion, hold, and incident duties.
Understands every storage class and confirms no operational store is Git, an application/provider, production, or unapproved personal location.
Will approve only minimum fields, least privilege, attributed logs, encryption, bounded validity, and separate backup controls.
Is not a scorer/adjudicator and does not recruit, coach, interpret, score, change results, or operate comparison.
Has no conflict capable of distorting access, hold, deletion, or incident decisions.
Will maintain the bounded inventory, purpose, controller, access, creation, deletion, backup, and hold metadata without secrets.
Will deny unrestricted narratives and unnecessary identities, credentials, paths, fixture/key text, responses, or scores.
Will issue only necessary, scoped holds with reason, owner, start, access, objective trigger, and review no later than 30 days.
Will verify deletion from primary, temporary, export, rejected-input, log, and aligned backup copies.
Will stop on leakage, unexplained access, inventory mismatch, overcollection, missed deletion, unreviewed hold, unapproved store/export, or uncertain erasure.
Will preserve only minimum incident evidence and prevent incident detail becoming an unbounded store.
Will re-review access and retention after relevant role, topology, protocol, incident, closure, or necessary-hold change.
